narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: The evangelist; grave and intimate, the night of the Last Supper.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord at the Last Supper: tender, unhurried farewell to his own; solemn in the priestly prayer.

peter.name: Simon Peter
peter.note: Impetuous and devoted; protests the washing, then vows to lay down his life.

john.name: John, the beloved disciple
john.note: The disciple whom Jesus loved, leaning on his breast; a quiet, close question.

1.t: Before the festival day of the pasch, Jesus knowing that his hour was come, that he should pass out of this world to the Father: having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them unto the end.

2.t: And when supper was done (the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon, to betray him),

3.t: Knowing that the Father had given him all things into his hands and that he came from God and goeth to God,

4.t: He riseth from supper and layeth aside his garments and, having taken a towel, girded himself.

5.t: After that, he putteth water into a basin and began to wash the feet of the disciples and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded.

6.t: He cometh therefore to Simon Peter. And Peter saith to him:
Lord, dost thou wash my feet?

7.t: Jesus answered and said to him:
What I do, thou knowest not now; but thou shalt know hereafter.

8.t: Thou shalt never wash my feet,
If I wash thee not, thou shalt have no part with me.

9.t: Lord, not only my feet, but also my hands and my head.

10.t: He that is washed needeth not but to wash his feet, but is clean wholly. And you are clean, but not all.

11.t: For he knew who he was that would betray him; therefore he said:

11.q: the narrator repeats Jesus' words of v.10 in direct form; given to jesus as spoken words, could stay narrator

12.t: Then after he had washed their feet and taken his garments, being set down again, he said to them:
Know you what I have done to you?

13.t: You call me Master and Lord. And you say well: for so I am.

14.t: If then I being your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; you also ought to wash one another's feet.

15.t: For I have given you an example, that as I have done to you, so you do also.

16.t: Amen, amen, I say to you: The servant is not greater than his lord: neither is the apostle greater than he that sent him.

17.t: If you know these things, you shall be blessed if you do them.

18.t: I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen. But that the scripture may be fulfilled: He that eateth bread with me shall lift up his heel against me,

19.t: At present I tell you, before it come to pass: that when it shall come to pass, you may believe that I am he.

20.t: Amen, amen, I say to you, he that receiveth whomsoever I send receiveth me: and he that receiveth me receiveth him that sent me.

21.t: When Jesus had said these things, he was troubled in spirit; and he testified, and said:
Amen, amen, I say to you, one of you shall betray me.

22.t: The disciples therefore looked one upon another, doubting of whom he spoke.

23.t: Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved.

24.t: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him and said to him:
Who is it of whom he speaketh?

25.t: He therefore, leaning on the breast of Jesus, saith to him:

26.t: He it is to whom I shall reach bread dipped.
And when he had dipped the bread, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon.

27.t: And after the morsel, Satan entered into him. And Jesus said to him:
That which thou dost, do quickly.

28.t: Now no man at the table knew to what purpose he said this unto him.

29.t: For some thought, because Judas had the purse, that Jesus had said to him: Buy those things which we have need of for the festival day: or that he should give something to the poor.
29.q: words some supposed Jesus had said (Buy those things...): a conjecture trailing into indirect speech, never actually spoken, so kept as narration

30.t: He therefore, having received the morsel, went out immediately. And it was night.

31.t: When he therefore was gone out, Jesus said:
Now is the Son of man glorified; and God is glorified in him.

32.t: If God be glorified in him, God also will glorify him in himself: and immediately will he glorify him.

33.t: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You shall seek me. And as I said to the Jews: Whither I go you cannot come; so I say to you now.

34.t: A new commandment I give unto you: That you love one another, as I have loved you, that you also love one another.

35.t: By this shall all men know that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another.

36.t: Whither I go, thou canst not follow me now: but thou shalt follow hereafter.

37.t: Why cannot I follow thee now? I will lay down my life for thee.

38.t: Wilt thou lay down thy life for me? Amen, amen, I say to thee, the cock shall not crow, till thou deny me thrice.
